CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of General Epistle: James? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Epistle: James.
   B. Use General Epistle: James to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say General Epistle: James has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of General Epistle: James with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o? (1 mark)

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Law, Order and Justice and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Modern medicine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Bible Study Methods Devotional Method and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Biblical Stewardship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
